title: DuckStation 0.1-11580: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-11580 on July 8, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-11580 on July 8, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: abf946c88 Update ukrainian translation ( 3762). c80552f1c Ukrainian translation v2 ( 3764). ab30d1da5 FileSystem: Make CopyFilePath() atomic. acfd60ea5 Deps: Update to 20260702.
